node.statement: Theorem 6.3 (Theorem 1.6 — Mix+(GPS) moments, tight): E[rho_hat_v^lambda tensor rho_hat_v^lambda] = ((n-1)/n)rho^2 + (1/n)(rho tensor I + I tensor rho)SWAP + (E[ell(lambda)]/n^2)SWAP - Lower_rho where Lower_rho in SoS(d). Proof: Same as Theorem 6.1 but conditioned on lambda. The key difference: conditioned on lambda, the purification lives in C^d tensor C^{ell(lambda)} (since V_lambda^r = 0 when lambda has more than r parts, the effective ancilla dimension is ell(lambda)). So the r in the SWAP coefficient becomes ell(lambda). Averaging over lambda gives E[ell(lambda)]/n^2, which is <= r/n^2 and can be much smaller when rho has rapidly decaying eigenvalues.
